verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev documents a GitHub Actions workflow that deploys tasks on push to main, and an official CLI with commands for projects, runs and environment management. It also offers a management API authenticated by environment secret keys or personal access tokens, and tasks can be triggered programmatically from backend code. Together these support headless, CI-driven automation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CI/headless usage (community posts praise dev mode and scheduling, not CI pipelines).
